name: UTZLINE Solid Surface Schedule
description: Standalone Solid Surface delivery/manufacture scheduling companion for the UTZLINE family, scoped to only the joinery items flagged "Has Solid Surface": set a required delivery date and manufacture lead time per item (right-click/long-press/tap its marker on a read-only plan view, pre-filled from the main Scheduler's own delivery date the first time), see the computed manufacture start date, and browse a sortable overall or per-project schedule with current status and delay flags -- fully independent of the main Scheduler once its own record is saved.
